description: Officials told Moneycontrol existing facility at Vikasa Soudha has run out of expansion space. The new STPI campus in Electronics City will become the state's primary data centre, while current facility will be converted into a disaster recovery site.
body_lead: Karnataka government is set to shift Karnataka State Data Centre (KSDC) from Vikasa Soudha to Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) campus in Electronics City, as it looks to expand computing capacity and build digital infrastructure capable of supporting emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML).
